docker.start: docker run --rm --name metaloop-{id} -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=metaloop -e MYSQL_DATABASE=app -p 127.0.0.1:{port}:3306 mysql:8.4

requires.install: install and start Docker Desktop (or another Docker engine)

native.init: mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P {port} -uroot -e 'CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS app'

requires.check: command -v mysqld && command -v mysqladmin && command -v mysql
requires.install: brew install mysql@8.4 (macOS) · apt install mysql-server (Linux)
